options.name: a_actionlist
options.description: The list of actions to perform on the ACME certificate after being issued/renewed.

options.name: a_domainlist
options.description: The list of domain verifications to include in the ACME certificate.

options.name: acmeaccount
options.description: The ACME account key to use for the ACME certificate.

options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: descr
options.description: A description of the ACME certificate.

options.name: dnssleep
options.description: The number of seconds to wait for DNS propagation before requesting verification.

options.name: keylength
options.description: The length of the private key to use for the ACME certificate.

options.name: keypaste
options.description: The custom private key to use for the ACME certificate.

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the ACME certificate.

options.name: oscpstaple
options.description: Whether to enable OCSP Stapling for the ACME certificate.

options.name: preferredchain
options.description: The preferred certificate chain to use for the ACME certificate.

options.name: renewafter
options.description: The number of days before expiration to renew the ACME certificate.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: status
options.description: The activation status of the ACME certificate.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
